short.en: The first space station module component, Zarya, for the International Space Station is launched from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan.
The founding congress of the Communist Party of Transcarpathian Ukraine is held in Mukachevo.
short.zh: 外喀尔巴阡乌克兰共产党成立大会在穆卡切沃举行。

short.en: Second Vatican Council: The third session of the Roman Catholic Church's ecumenical council closes.
short.zh: 梵蒂冈第二届大公会议：罗马天主教教会的第三次大公会议闭幕。

short.en: Can we talk about this later? I'm kind of busy right now.
short.zh: 这事能晚点说吗？我现在有点忙。
short.note: kind of 口语弱读；later 的 /t/ 轻触。

short.en: Rebecca Latimer Felton of Georgia takes the oath of office, becoming the first female United States Senator.
Memory has a way of keeping what we choose to forget.
short.zh: 记忆总会留下我们想忘掉的东西。
short.note: have a way of 有……的方式；choose to do 选择做。

short.en: The new kid in class seems pretty cool.
short.zh: 班上新来的同学看起来挺酷。
short.note: kid 口语指“孩子/同学”；seems 后接形容词。

short.en: It's raining outside, so take an umbrella with you.
short.note: raining 双音节；umbrella 重音在第二音节。

short.en: The 83-year-old singer is accused of abusing two former employees at Caribbean residences in 2021.
short.zh: 这位 83 岁的歌手被指控于 2021 年在加勒比住宅虐待两名前雇员。

short.en: Anthropic is the first purely AI company to be publicly listed, creating a test for the entire industry.
A stampede in Kwekwe, Zimbabwe caused by the police firing tear gas kills at least eleven people and injures 40 others.
short.zh: 津巴布韦克韦克韦发生踩踏事件，原因是警察发射催泪瓦斯，造成至少 11 人死亡，40 人受伤。

short.en: Let's circle back to this point in the next call.
short.zh: 我们下次通话再回到这一点上。
short.note: circle back 是商务高频表达；point 双元音 /ɔɪ/。

short.en: Don't stop when you're tired. Stop when you're done.
Thousands marched across European cities on Friday to protest against the cost of living and other issues.
short.zh: 周五，成千上万人走上欧洲各城市的街头，抗议生活成本和其他问题。

short.en: Hamas condemned the incursion, which the Israeli military said was to dismantle a "terror tunnel", as a "flagrant" ceasefire violation.
The students were caught with banned smart devices while taking the high-stakes Suneung exam.
short.zh: 学生们在参加高风险的“高考”时被发现携带违禁智能设备。

short.en: Speak any language, turkish, greek, persian, arabic, but always speak with love.
We should keep stakeholders informed of the progress.
short.zh: 我们应让相关方随时了解进展。
short.note: keep sb informed of 是固定结构；stakeholders 音节较多，注意断句。

short.en: We must accept finite disappointment, but never lose infinite hope.
Fiona, who became an internet star after her premature birth in 2017, "fought until she couldn’t anymore", the zoo says.

long.en: Taking care of your body does not require difficult plans. A regular sleep schedule, enough water, and short breaks to stretch your shoulders can make a real difference in how you feel by the end of the day.
long.zh: 照顾身体并不需要复杂的计划。规律作息、足量饮水，再加上起身活动肩膀的短暂休息，都会明显改变你一天结束时的状态。
long.note: 动名词主语 Taking care of；make a difference 有影响；stretch /stretʃ/。

long.en: Last summer we traveled to a small town near the coast, where the air smelled of salt and the streets were lined with old stone houses. We spent our mornings walking along the beach and our evenings talking with local people over dinner.
long.zh: 去年夏天我们去了海边一个小镇，空气里带着咸味，街道两旁是老旧的石屋。上午我们在海滩散步，晚上和当地人边吃晚饭边聊天。
long.note: be lined with 两旁排列；spend time doing 结构；coast 双元音 /oʊ/。

long.en: Public libraries are quiet places where anyone can read, study, or borrow books. They connect people with knowledge, and they remain an important part of community life even in the age of the internet. A regular reading habit can broaden our view of the world and improve our ability to think clearly.
long.zh: 公共图书馆是安静的场所，任何人都可以在那里阅读、学习或借阅书籍。即使在互联网时代，它们仍是社区生活的重要部分。长期阅读能拓宽视野，提升清晰思考的能力。
long.note: 定语从句 where anyone... 注意衔接；community 重音在第二音节；broaden /ˈbrɔːdn/。

words.z: a. 苦的, 痛苦的, 怀恨的
n. 外科医生, 军医, 船医
a. 艺术的, 艺术家的, 富有艺术性的
n. 读写能力, 识字, 精通文学
n. 国库, 宝库, 财政部, 国库券
